items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you meet Miley? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Bubber Miley? Yeah, sure thing. Bubber Miley and Tricky Sam (PHONETIC) and all these, yeah.

ctx.x: Sonny Greer told me that you couldn't get him on the bandstand with Bubber Miley (inaudible).
Well, you see, Bubber Miley would get up

there and confound him because you'd hear something and you said, well, what is he doing up there, and you'd forget what you were doing. Because you'd be hearing some stuff and you'd forget what you were doing. So you're not going to take no chances. You're going to play just what you could execute. You're not going out and try -- you see what I mean?
